commands:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=3997b2a0bc2bbdb30a4aa0fbf62648c32b6bb52d
git fetch origin main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 michal@192.168.0.23 'bash -s' <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
echo production_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo service_status=$(sudo -n systemctl is-active photomap.service)
echo '--- unit metadata ---'
sudo -n systemctl show photomap.service -p FragmentPath -p WorkingDirectory -p ExecStart -p EnvironmentFiles --no-pager
echo '--- candidate db files ---'
find /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps -maxdepth 5 -type f \( -name '*.db' -o -name '*.sqlite' -o -name '*.sqlite3' \) -printf '%p %s bytes\n' | sort
echo '--- open database files ---'
PID=$(sudo -n systemctl show photomap.service -p MainPID --value)
if [ "$PID" != 0 ]; then sudo -n find /proc/$PID/fd -maxdepth 1 -type l -printf '%l\n' 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.(db|sqlite|sqlite3)(-|$)' | sort -u || true; fi
REMOTE
